claim: The new `continue` on key-kind mismatch changes generator output for users who do not set SuppressSourceGeneration. Previously a member that mixed int and string keys still fell through and was added to intMembers/stringMembers after MsgPack0xx was reported. Now it is dropped, so the generated formatter omits that member. The build already errors on the diagnostic, but users with that diagnostic suppressed or downgraded now get different generated code and different serialized bytes.
